welcome_dialog.title: Welcome to CARA
welcome_dialog.message:
Thanks for installing CARA.

As this is your first time starting the application, I would recommend that you take a quick look at the Getting Started section of the manual.

It covers the most important aspects of configuring and using CARA, so that you will hopefully have a great time and enjoy using the application.

You will also find a link to CARA's YouTube channel with many tutorial videos
in the Help menu.

If you enjoy the project, please consider leaving a Star on the GitHub repository, subscribing to and liking the YouTube channel/videos, and spreading the word!

Best regards, Philipp.

custom_endpoint_disclaimer.title: Custom Endpoint Disclaimer
custom_endpoint_disclaimer.message:
Experimental feature: Custom endpoint support is an experimental implementation. Responses from locally run models may not match the quality of top-tier cloud models (e.g. OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude).

Local models may be less accurate, less consistent, or occasionally produce incorrect or irrelevant answers. Use at your own discretion.

descriptions.exact_pgn: Match games with identical PGN strings (headers + moves). This is the most strict matching mode.
descriptions.moves_only: Match games with identical moves, ignoring header information. Useful when the same game appears with different metadata.
descriptions.normalized_pgn: Match games after removing comments, variations, annotations, and extra whitespace. Useful when PGN formatting differs.
descriptions.header_based: Match games based on selected header fields. Useful when you want to identify games by specific metadata rather than moves.

copy.welcome_body:
Stockfish is a free, open-source chess engine and the easiest way to get started with analysis in CARA.

This assistant will download an official Stockfish build for your computer, save it to a folder you choose, and add it to CARA.
copy.official_note: Downloads come from the official Stockfish GitHub releases ({url}).
copy.looking_up_release: Looking up the latest official release…
copy.binary_hint: Keep the recommended build unless you know your CPU needs a different variant.

You can also download manually from {url} and use Engines → Add Engine…

Downloading {filename}

copy.validate_checking:
Checking that the downloaded engine starts and responds to the UCI protocol…

This can take a few seconds.
copy.validate_failed_hint:
The download finished, but CARA could not use this binary as a UCI engine.

Common causes:
• Wrong or incompatible build for this computer
• The operating system blocked the executable (permissions / SmartScreen / Gatekeeper)
• Antivirus quarantined or modified the file

You can go back and choose a different build, or download manually from {url} and use Engines → Add Engine…

regex_presets.label: Custom…
regex_presets.tooltip: Enter your own regular expression in Find / Replace.

regex_presets.label: Keep only matched substring
regex_presets.tooltip: Keeps only the part matched inside the first (…). Replace "text to keep" with the literal text or a pattern such as Candidates or [A-Za-z ]+.

regex_presets.label: Remove matched text
regex_presets.tooltip: Removes only the part matched by "text to remove" while keeping the text before and after it. Replace that placeholder with the literal text or a pattern such as \([^)]*\) or -\s*.*$.

regex_presets.label: Keep text before "-"
regex_presets.tooltip: Example: "Wijk aan Zee - Masters" or "Wijk aan Zee-Masters" → "Wijk aan Zee".

regex_presets.label: Keep text after "-"
regex_presets.tooltip: Example: "Wijk aan Zee - Masters" or "Wijk aan Zee-Masters" → "Masters".

regex_presets.label: Remove rating in (…)
regex_presets.tooltip: Example: "Carlsen (2830)" → "Carlsen". Matches a 3–4 digit rating inside parentheses.

regex_presets.label: Keep digits only
regex_presets.tooltip: Example: "elo 2755" or "~2755" → "2755". Useful for WhiteElo / BlackElo cleanup.

regex_presets.label: Keep first three words
regex_presets.tooltip: Drops everything after the first three whitespace-separated words.

regex_presets.label: Remove titles (GM/IM/FM/…)
regex_presets.tooltip: Removes common title prefixes such as GM, IM, FM, WGM, and NM (optional trailing period). Edit the title list if you need additional titles.

regex_presets.label: Remove country/federation code
regex_presets.tooltip: Removes a trailing 3-letter federation/country code, optionally in [ ] or ( ). Example: "Wijk aan Zee NED" or "Berlin [GER]" → city/event only.

regex_presets.label: Remove time-control fragment
regex_presets.tooltip: Removes common time-control tokens such as 10+0, 15+10, G/90, or 15|10 from Event (and similar) tags.

passed_pawn.name: Passed Pawn
passed_pawn.description: Evaluates passed pawns (pawns with no enemy pawns in front)

backward_pawn.name: Backward Pawn
backward_pawn.description: Evaluates backward pawns (pawns behind friendly pawns that cannot advance safely)

isolated_pawn.name: Isolated Pawn
isolated_pawn.description: Evaluates isolated pawns (pawns with no friendly pawns on adjacent files)

doubled_pawn.name: Doubled Pawn
doubled_pawn.description: Evaluates doubled pawns (multiple pawns on the same file)

king_safety.name: King Safety
king_safety.description: Evaluates king safety (open files, pawn shield, exposed king)

weak_square.name: Weak Square
weak_square.description: Evaluates weak squares (squares that cannot be defended by pawns)

piece_activity.name: Piece Activity
piece_activity.description: Evaluates piece activity (mobility and central control)

undeveloped_piece.name: Undeveloped Piece
undeveloped_piece.description: Evaluates undeveloped pieces (pieces still on starting squares and blocked)

outpost_square.name: Outpost Square
outpost_square.description: Evaluates outpost squares (squares that must be protected by friendly pawns and cannot be attacked by enemy pawns)
